description: Release-chain updates (geyserlite -> gate -> moxy) must never be starved by the global PR backlog: the chain package rules get prPriority 100 so they are created first, and the concurrent limit keeps headroom above the stale-PR backlog that previously rate-limited geyserlite (Dependency Dashboard #119, v0.5.22 stuck for days behind 11 stale PRs at the default prConcurrentLimit of 10).

packageRules.description: Gate's example modules replace the root module locally, so version bumps of Gate itself only create release loops.
